dialogue.text: How old is your baby, and has the baby passed any stool at all since birth?
My baby is 2 days old. No, he hasn't passed any stool at all since he was born, which is really worrying me.
When did the vomiting start, and can you describe it — is it green or yellowish in color, and does it happen after every feed?
The vomiting started yesterday, about a day after he was born. Yes, it's green in color, and it seems to happen after most of his feedings.

Thank you — that green vomiting is important. Was the pregnancy normal, and did any prenatal ultrasounds show anything unusual, such as extra amniotic fluid? Also, is there any family history of cystic fibrosis or bowel problems in infancy?
The pregnancy was normal, and we didn't have any ultrasounds since we planned a home birth. There's no family history of cystic fibrosis or bowel problems that we know of.

When you examine the baby's bottom, does the anus appear normal and open? And when I examine him, I'd like to check — has anyone done a rectal exam, and if so, was there any gush of stool or gas afterward?
The anus looks normal to me. No, no one has done a rectal exam on him yet.
Given the distension and no meconium in 48 hours, I need imaging first. REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_X-Ray
RESULTS: Abdominal X-ray shows dilated loops of bowel with no gas in the rectum, suggestive of a distal obstruction.
The X-ray confirms a distal bowel obstruction. To pinpoint the cause, I'd like a contrast study of the lower bowel. REQUEST TEST: Contrast_Enema
